title: A/R Summary forgets the sort between visits
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The report has open documents on today's date.
  • Starting screen: A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Total" header.
  2. Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu).
  3. Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the rows sort by Total, largest first.
  • Step 2: Sales By Customer opens.
  • Step 3: A/R Summary opens in its opening order again, with the customer name column (the first column) marked as the sorted column (a small arrow beside its heading); the Total sort is not remembered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R8: “The sort is not remembered between visits: opening the report again starts from Story 1's order.”
  • S1-R7: “The column the report opened on is marked as sorted: the name column on the Summaries and Detail reports, the Date column on Collection and Unpaid Invoices.”
